sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Let us Read 8 The Decision of the Panchayat Once upon a time, there lived a farmer in a small village.
sections.source_evidence: Let us Read 8 The Decision of the Panchayat Once upon a time, there lived a farmer in a small village.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: When he prospered, he bought another field.
sections.source_evidence: When he prospered, he bought another field.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: Since the farmer needed a source of water for his fields, he bought the well from his neighbour.
sections.source_evidence: Since the farmer needed a source of water for his fields, he bought the well from his neighbour.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: He thought of a plan to cheat the farmer.
sections.source_evidence: He thought of a plan to cheat the farmer.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: 92 Santoor Grade 5 The next day, when the farmer reached the well, he found the neighbour standing there.
sections.source_evidence: 92 Santoor Grade 5 The next day, when the farmer reached the well, he found the neighbour standing there.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: He refused to let the farmer take water from the well.
sections.source_evidence: He refused to let the farmer take water from the well.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: On asking why, he replied, “I sold only the well to you, not the water.
sections.source_evidence: On asking why, he replied, “I sold only the well to you, not the water.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: You cannot take it.” The worried farmer didn’t know what to do.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: So, he went to the village chief and told her about his case, and said, “He is not letting me take the water.” The village chief fixed a day for a meeting of the Panchayat.
sections.source_evidence: So, he went to the village chief and told her about his case, and said, “He is not letting me take the water.” The village chief fixed a day for a meeting of the Panchayat.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: The day came, and the members of the Panchayat gathered under the banyan tree in the centre of the village.
sections.source_evidence: The day came, and the members of the Panchayat gathered under the banyan tree in the centre of the village.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: Both the farmer and his neighbour were summoned.
sections.source_evidence: Both the farmer and his neighbour were summoned.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: The farmer explained the situation to the gathering.
sections.source_evidence: The farmer explained the situation to the gathering.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: The chief asked the neighbour why he was not letting the farmer draw water from the well.
sections.source_evidence: The chief asked the neighbour why he was not letting the farmer draw water from the well.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: The cunning man said the same thing again, “I sold only the well to him, not the water in it.
sections.source_evidence: The cunning man said the same thing again, “I sold only the well to him, not the water in it.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: So, he cannot take my water.” The members of the Panchayat, as well as the villagers, tried to reason with him, but he was adamant.
sections.source_evidence: So, he cannot take my water.” The members of the Panchayat, as well as the villagers, tried to reason with him, but he was adamant.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: Finally, the Panchayat members discussed the matter among themselves.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: Then they stood up to give the judgment.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: 94 Santoor Grade 5 The village chief began, “After hearing both sides, we agree that it is correct to say that only the well was sold.” The neighbour gave a satisfied smile.
sections.source_evidence: 94 Santoor Grade 5 The village chief began, “After hearing both sides, we agree that it is correct to say that only the well was sold.” The neighbour gave a satisfied smile.

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: “However,” continued the village chief, “if you have NOT sold the water and the water is yours, then you have no business keeping your water in his well.
sections.source_evidence: “However,” continued the village chief, “if you have NOT sold the water and the water is yours, then you have no business keeping your water in his well.

sections.heading: Learning Point 20
sections.content: Remove the water or use it all up immediately.
